name: 選んだ食材の量と除外を調整する
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE complete Japanese Lighthouse ingredient quantity/exclusion picker LH19-0005, portrait compact composition, pure white canvas.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: image1 ORIGINAL sweetgreen screen has HIGHEST priority for exact minus glyph geometry, circular controls, quantity indicators, icon optical weight, spacing and precise selection detail. Image2 is the ORIGINAL unselected state with all six food photos and highest authority for their anatomy/crops. Image3 Japanese native mock is SECONDARY content/layout only; do not reproduce rough substitute icons. Image4 is the exact ORIGINAL arugula crop. Image5 approved Lighthouse bus style only guides white rounded surfaces and gradient green selected controls. All six individual original food crops were inspected: arugula scattered thin leaves/stems; baby spinach three broad leaves; romaine leafy upright wedge; quinoa warm granular mound; kale frilled stem leaf; spring mix four differently shaped green/red leaves. Preserve actual food shapes, arrangement and colors shown in original screens, no substitutes. Tool accepts at most5 inputs so the other five inspected crops are represented by the original source screen.
Component contains section 「選んだ食材」 with TWO selected cards: 「ルッコラ」 and 「ベビーほうれん草」, each food photo, lower-left white neutral thin-outline circular MINUS with crisp horizontal line, lower-right green circular 「1」 quantity indicator. Then fine neutral divider and heading 「ベース」. Below a THREE-column TWO-row grid of SIX cards:
row1 「ルッコラ」, 「ベビーほうれん草」, 「刻みロメインレタス」
row2 「ハーブ入りキヌア」, 「刻みケール」, 「ミックスリーフ」.
First two grid cards are selected, with same minus and quantity1; other four are unselected and have no added quantity, plus, checkmark or removal controls. All food photos appropriate to exact crop. Preserve 2 selected summary cards and 6 candidate cards, not 8 unique foods.
White rounded cards, neutral hairline borders, restrained soft shadow, selected cards distinguished by forest-green outline plus count1; keep interiors white instead of source broad green/beige cards. Photo background beige may remain only inside original crop. Green count circles subtle gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E, white numerals. Minus slate #526173, other text ink. This purposeful selected-state green is the only UI accent. Do not remove selection distinction or turn every card green.
Typography locked Meiryo heading Bold20/28 for ベース, compact section role preserved, body Regular14/24, metadata12/16, tracking0. Wrap long ingredient names neatly without clipping. No title above 選んだ食材, no extra photos, hidden/cropped lower source candidates, price, total, footer buttons, navigation or confirmation. Render the complete target in modest compact whitespace, no heavy gloss, broad tint, watermark.
reviewNotes: 全原本2画面・6切抜き・モック・状態編集を実見。選択済2件＋候補6件、数量1と除外4箇所、白面と森林色選択を確認。原本をアイコン詳細の上位参照として入力。刻みロメインレタスの折返しがモック2行から1行へ変化し、写真は生成の再構成差が残る。これらを要修正で保存。所有者承認・ネイティブ編集・数量自動連動・アプリ動作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
